card.title: IPhone 11 Not Powering on, After Prompt to Boot Current Jumps Back and Forth From 0 A to 320 mA, Then 0 A to 1.4 A, Then 0 A to 500 mA, and so on

source.title: IPhone 11 Not Powering on, After Prompt to Boot Current Jumps Back and Forth From 0 A to 320 mA, Then 0 A to 1.4 A, Then 0 A to 500 mA, and so on

claims.statement: iPhone 11 with no pre-boot draw and current bouncing after power-on usually has a shorted cap on PP2V63_NAND, PP1V8_NAND or PP0V9_NAND; PMIC heating during injection is not the cause.

procedure: Inject voltage; remove the shorted cap.
card.caveats: Source names PMIC U1801, which looks carried over from iPhone 7 guides. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
